name: rime-wanxiang
tagline: AI-optimized 'Wanxiang' Chinese input method built on Rime
description: rime-wanxiang (万象拼音) is a Chinese pinyin input method built on the Rime engine, optimized with an AI-tuned word library and grammar model. It ships with eight auxiliary codes and is one of the trending Lua projects on GitHub. For Chinese users who want a modern, highly customizable, open-source input method, it combines the flexibility of Rime with an AI-refined typing experience.
highlights: AI-optimized word library and grammar model for accurate typing
Built on the highly customizable Rime engine
Eight auxiliary codes for power users
One of the trending Lua projects on GitHub
curatorNote: Rime is already the gold standard for customizable input methods; adding an AI-refined word model makes it even more compelling for daily Chinese typing.
